Name: 2 Truths & 1 Lie - RAC JPN Edition
Description:
On 18th July 2025, the Rotaract Club of JP Nagar conducted its first member engagement event of the new term — “2 Truths & 1 Lie – RAC JPN Edition” — through Google Meet. The activity served as a warm, informal icebreaker designed to initiate bonding among members across various levels of the club.

The event saw active participation from 30 members, including 18 board members, 8 new inductees, and 4 existing members. The format was simple yet highly interactive — each participant shared two true statements and one false one about themselves, while others guessed which was the lie. This sparked curiosity, laughter, and friendly banter, creating a joyful and engaging virtual space.

The event successfully broke the ice among newly inducted members and gave everyone an opportunity to interact beyond formal settings. It also helped members discover common interests, unique traits, and fun facts about one another, thereby fostering deeper club camaraderie.

The session not only set a positive tone for the upcoming term but also reinforced the importance of human connection and shared stories in club-building. It was well-received by all attendees and marked a confident and lively start to the club’s fellowship calendar for 2025–2026

Name: Royal Clicku, Mitra Picku
Description: The Installation came alive with the vibrant spirit of Royal Clicku, Mitra Picku. Guests entered with curiosity and excitement, each picking their Mitra from the chits, setting the stage for a unique bonding experience. As people found their peers and clicked those playful royal selfies, a magical atmosphere of camaraderie blossomed. It was more than just an icebreaker; it became a moment where friendships were forged, laughter echoed, and introductions were made with genuine warmth—truly a spectacle of human connection celebrated like royalty. The gallery of selfies captured glimpses of sparkling smiles and new bonds, immortalizing the joy of the event. The phrase “Sneha shuruvavagodu, ondu chittiyinda!” was truly embodied in every interaction, reminding us how a simple chit can spark lasting friendships. This Installation wasn’t just an event—it was a memorable journey of bringing strangers closer, creating stories worth sharing, and celebrating the royal experience of togetherness
Venue: Padmabhushana Dr H. Narasimhaiah Multimedia Hall, National College

Name: Outgoing RIDE to RI District 3206 - Coimbatore & Palakkad
Description:
Rtr. Adithya N from the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar participated in an extraordinary outbound Rotaract Inter District Exchange (RIDE), representing our club and RI District 3191 in a vibrant cultural and service immersion with RI District 3206. Held from July 17 to 20, 2025, this exchange brought together Rotaractors committed to fostering new connections, sharing best practices, and building lifelong friendships across districts.

The journey began as a team of three passionate Rotaractors—Rtr. Mohammed Mujtaba, Rtr. Muskan Agrawal, and Rtr. Adithya N—set out to Coimbatore, the heart of RID 3206 and the host district for this meaningful exchange.

Day 1 opened with a warm and enthusiastic welcome from the Rotaract Club of Sai Baba Colony. The hospitality and camaraderie set the tone for the adventure ahead. The day was packed with visits to iconic sites: the spiritual Marudhamalai Temple, the tranquil Siruvani River, Kattimala, and Jallipara. As we explored the raw beauty of Attapadi and paused at Mannarkad, nature and fellowship blended seamlessly, creating memories to cherish. The evening wound down with a hearty dinner and a leisurely stroll along Race Course Road—a perfect close to a spirited opening day.

Day 2 was curated by the Rotaract Club of Coimbatore Uptown. After a delicious breakfast, our group embarked on local explorations, discovering the serene Malampuzha Dam and the picturesque Kava River. We soaked in the colors and fragrance of Coimbatore’s famous flower market and experienced the modern pulse of Lulu Mall. Over dinner and in conversation on Race Course Road, we built bridges with local Rotaractors, exchanging stories and perspectives on community leadership.

Day 3 brought a new highlight, hosted jointly by RaC Sai Baba Colony and RaC Coimbatore City. The day was dedicated to the host club’s installation ceremony—a vibrant gathering attended by the DRR, IPDRR, DRRE, and presidents from various Coimbatore clubs. Laughter and learning filled the air during an engaging orientation session. After a dynamic valedictory featuring cultural performances, RaC Coimbatore City seamlessly took over hosting duties. The evening concluded with another delightful dinner, more networking, and the official handover of logistics, reflecting the seamless spirit of Rotaract collaboration.

Day 4, the final stretch, was graciously led by RaC PSGR Krishnammal College for Women. After breakfast, we set out for an excursion to Pollachi, exploring the scenic beauty of Aliyar Dam and the enchanting Monkey Falls. The day slowed down with a peaceful and reflective visit to Brookfields Mall, where we met members from RaC Coimbatore Crystal and other dedicated Rotaractors. New friends, fond farewells, and promises of future collaboration marked the perfect end as we headed to the departure point, filled with gratitude and inspiration.

Throughout these four days, the exchange was more than just sightseeing or ceremonies—it was about deepening our understanding of each other's cultures, approaches to service, and shared vision as Rotaractors. We left Coimbatore not just as guests, but as cherished members of a larger Rotaract family, carrying forward the torch of service, friendship, and inter-district kinship.

This experience beautifully encapsulated the essence of Rotaract—serving, connecting, and growing together—and reinforced our collective mission to make a difference wherever we go.

Name: Let's Nurture Nature
Description:
On July 12, 2025, the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar, in proud collaboration with KPMG CSR, came together for a truly impactful community service project in Kolar, Karnataka. Early in the morning, volunteers assembled at the KPMG office, energized for the journey ahead. There was excitement in the air as these changemakers set out, determined to nurture nature and create a greener tomorrow.

The trip from Bangalore to Kandlevaaripalli felt less like a commute and more like a celebration of purpose. The volunteers bonded over shared laughter, playful moments, and lively desi tunes echoing throughout the bus. It was clear from the very beginning that this was a gathering defined by positive energy and unity.

Arriving at Kandlevaaripalli in Srinivasapura Taluk, everyone channeled their enthusiasm into action. Under the warm sunlight, and fueled by a genuine determination to make a difference, the volunteers—comprising members from Bangalore JP Nagar, KGF - SBMJC, KGF Community, and Jayanagar—set about planting 250 saplings. Each sapling, whether a Guava or a Chikoo, was planted with care and hope, transforming barren land into a living testament of their commitment. For many, learning the art of planting was a joyful discovery. The new skills, coupled with the thrill of making a tangible impact, turned hard work into an enjoyable, memorable challenge.

As the morning gave way to noon, the once-empty terrain now shimmered with fresh green saplings, each a living promise for the future. The volunteers were rewarded with a sumptuous home-cooked meal from the local landowners, made with love and authentic flavors that nourished both body and spirit. This meal was not just about food, but about sharing and gratitude—a perfect conclusion to a meaningful day.

Thanks to KPMG’s thoughtful support with travel, snacks, and equipment, the volunteers focused entirely on their passion for service and sustainability. The day’s efforts vividly reflected the power of teamwork, the joy of community, and the hope that rests in every small act of stewardship.

The plantation drive was more than just an event; it was a movement. It reaffirmed the difference that dedicated individuals can make when united by purpose. The land now stood alive with possibility, and each participant returned home with memories of joy, friendship, and the knowledge that they had contributed to a brighter, greener future.
Areas of Focus: Growing Local Economies, Protecting The Environment
Host Club: Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar

Name: Income Tax and GST Awareness & Grievance Addressal Seminar
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar actively participated in the Tax Awareness and Grievance Addressal Seminar held on 1st August 2025 at Jain University Auditorium. The seminar, organized by Rotary Bangalore JP Nagar and co-sponsored by Rotary Bangalore Spandana, Rotary Bangalore South Samarpane, Rotary Bangalore Malhar, and Rotary Bangalore South Parade, was an enriching platform that aimed to spread awareness on Income Tax and GST while also addressing common taxpayer grievances.

The event featured distinguished speakers including Amrita Ranjan, IRS (Principal Commissioner of Income Tax–1, Bengaluru), Dr. Kotraswamy M, IRS (Commissioner, Central Taxes Zone, Bengaluru), Dr. CA. P. Vijay Anand (Chairperson, NTWF; Practising Chartered Accountant; Founder, Linbur Consulting), and S. Ramakrishnan, IRS (Retd.) (Secretary General, NTWF; Former Chief Commissioner of Income Tax). Their insights on taxation laws, compliance procedures, and practical challenges offered immense learning to all present.

A total of 11 Rotaractors from our club attended the seminar and benefitted from the valuable interactions with the esteemed panel. The participants gained greater clarity on taxation matters, particularly on Income Tax compliance and GST-related procedures, and had the opportunity to directly raise queries during the interactive sessions.

This seminar served as a highly informative experience for our members, enhancing their financial literacy and providing them with knowledge that can be applied in both personal and professional contexts. It also reinforced the importance of active participation in Rotary-organized initiatives that promote awareness and capacity-building among youth.

Name: Smile Please 3.0
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar successfully organized Smile Please 3.0 — a dental screening and treatment camp held on the 9th and 10th of August 2025 at Bandipur Tiger Reserve. Hosted under our flagship annual project “Smile Please,” the initiative was conducted in collaboration with Friends of Wildlife Association, Transforming Tomorrow Foundation (TTF), and The Oxford Dental College. The camp was dedicated to the frontline staff of Bandipur, the unsung heroes who protect our forests and wildlife with unwavering commitment.

Over two days, the camp provided dental check-ups, oral hygiene awareness, treatment, and free distribution of medicines to more than 200 forest personnel. Beneficiaries included staff from multiple ranges such as Mulehole, Bandipur, Kundkere, GS Betta, Yediyala, Omkar, along with members of the Special Tiger Protection Force (STPF) and the Dog Squad. By addressing their healthcare needs and providing free medicines, the camp ensured both immediate relief and long-term awareness on oral health.

This initiative was not just about medical care, but also about expressing gratitude to the forest staff for their relentless service in safeguarding our ecosystem. The event also garnered wide appreciation and was featured in Vijayavani, further amplifying its impact and spreading awareness about the importance of caring for those who protect our wildlife. For our club members, Smile Please 3.0 was a deeply meaningful service opportunity — one that combined healthcare, conservation, and community appreciation, truly embodying the spirit of Rotaract service.
External Partners: Friends of Wildlife Association, Transforming Tomorrow Foundation and The Oxford Dental College
Areas of Focus: Fighting Disease, Growing Local Economies, Protecting The Environment

Name: Tiranga Trails
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar celebrated Independence Day 2025 with a unique blend of patriotism, service, and fellowship through Tiranga Trails – JPN Special, held on 15th August 2025. The initiative combined an adventurous ride and trek with impactful community service activities, making the day both memorable and meaningful. A total of 16 members from our club participated with enthusiasm.

The day began with a convoy ride from Thalghatapura Metro Station to Hosadurga Village in Kanakapura Taluk, followed by a flag hoisting ceremony at the Government Panchayat School. The event was made special by the presence of students and local community members, with whom the spirit of freedom was celebrated.

The journey concluded with a scenic trek to Hosadurga Betta and a peaceful stop at Arkavathi Dam, where participants reflected on the significance of the day and the impact of their contributions.

Tiranga Trails – JPN Special successfully embodied the essence of Rotaract by combining club service, community service, fellowship, and adventure. It was a day that honored the nation, uplifted communities, strengthened friendships, and reminded everyone that true freedom lies in serving others.

Name: Project Belaku
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar celebrated Independence Day 2025 with a unique blend of patriotism, service, and fellowship through Tiranga Trails – JPN Special, held on 15th August 2025. The initiative combined an adventurous ride and trek with impactful community service activities, making the day both memorable and meaningful. A total of 16 members from our club participated with enthusiasm.

The day began with a convoy ride from Thalghatapura Metro Station to Hosadurga Village in Kanakapura Taluk, followed by a flag hoisting ceremony at the Government Panchayat School. The event was made special by the presence of students and local community members, with whom the spirit of freedom was celebrated.

As part of Project Belaku, members trekked to a remote tribal hamlet to distribute solar lamps to over 30 beneficiary households. This effort not only lit up homes but also brought hope and convenience to families living in areas without reliable electricity. The trek added a spirit of adventure while amplifying the sense of purpose in serving remote communities.
Areas of Focus: Growing Local Economies, Protecting The Environment

Name: Cookie Caravan
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar celebrated Independence Day 2025 with a unique blend of patriotism, service, and fellowship through Tiranga Trails – JPN Special, held on 15th August 2025. The initiative combined an adventurous ride and trek with impactful community service activities, making the day both memorable and meaningful. A total of 16 members from our club participated with enthusiasm.

The day began with a convoy ride from Thalghatapura Metro Station to Hosadurga Village in Kanakapura Taluk, followed by a flag hoisting ceremony at the Government Panchayat School. The event was made special by the presence of students and local community members, with whom the spirit of freedom was celebrated.

The community service extended further through a collaboration with Rotaract Aagneya for their flagship initiative, Cookie Caravan – Spreading Smiles, One Cookie at a Time. Together, we distributed cookies to over 200 students at the Government Panchayat School, Hosadurga Village, adding sweetness and joy to the Independence Day celebrations. The children’s smiles were a true highlight of the day, proving that small gestures can create lasting happiness.

Name: Royal Clicku, Mitra Picku - Part 2
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar hosted a memorable General Body Meeting at Lalbagh that came alive with the vibrant spirit of Royal Clicku, Mitra Picku - Part 2. As members gathered amidst the greenery, the unique icebreaker set the tone for an evening filled with laughter, camaraderie, and warmth. Each participant picked their “Mitra” from chits, sparking curiosity and excitement as pairs discovered each other.

What followed was a delightful exchange of conversations and playful royal selfies that captured the essence of friendship in its purest form. The activity went beyond a simple introduction — it created an atmosphere where strangers bonded effortlessly, new friendships blossomed, and existing ones grew stronger. The gallery of selfies stood as a joyful testimony to the connections made, with sparkling smiles and genuine moments immortalized in every click.

The phrase “Sneha shuruvavagodu, ondu chittiyinda!” was beautifully brought to life, reminding everyone how even a small gesture can ignite lasting bonds. This GBM was not just about discussions and updates, but about celebrating togetherness, strengthening ties, and creating memories that truly reflected the spirit of Rotaract fellowship.

Name: Tax is Easy 3.0
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar successfully organized the third edition of its flagship initiative, Tax Is Easy, on 29th August 2025. Conducted virtually on Google Meet, the session aimed at simplifying Income Tax Return filing and equipping participants with essential financial knowledge for better decision-making.

The session was led by our Club Secretary, CA Rtr. Anarghya Suvin, who brought professional expertise and practical insights to the discussion. Participants were guided through the fundamentals of income tax, filing procedures, and related compliance aspects. In addition, the session also covered broader financial literacy topics, including money management strategies and the importance of developing smart financial habits.

The interactive format allowed participants to clarify doubts in real time, making the session highly engaging and impactful. A total of 22 participants attended the session, which also included members from the Rotaract Club of Bangalore Jayanagar, making it a collaborative effort that broadened its reach and impact.

Name: Avighna
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar was delighted to be part of Avighna – Let Your Celebration Take Root in Nature, a beautiful eco-initiative organized by our fellow Rotaractors from the Rotaract Club of Bangalore Jayanagar.

The project carried a strong message of celebrating Ganesh Chaturthi in harmony with nature. Each thoughtfully designed Avighna kit included a plantable seed Ganesha idol, a coconut fiber pot, coconut peat manure, and seed balls—a simple yet impactful way of ensuring that after the festivities, Lord Ganesha continues to bless us by taking root and growing into a plant.

As part of our collaboration, our club purchased 10 Avighna kits and distributed them to our members during the General Body Meeting. Members were overjoyed to take them home and celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi in an eco-friendly way—making the festival not only devotional but also sustainable.

Name: Ganesha Chaturthi Showcase
Description:
On the occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi, members of the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar came together in high festive spirits to showcase their Ganesha and Gowri idols.

What began as a simple exchange of pictures soon turned into a vibrant celebration, filling the club with the warmth and energy of the festival. Members shared glimpses of celebrations from their homes, apartment complexes, and offices, each idol reflecting devotion and creativity.

The initiative not only created a festive atmosphere across the club but also fostered a sense of unity, cultural pride, and togetherness. It reminded everyone that beyond projects and service, the club thrives on shared traditions, celebrations, and the joy of being a family.

Name: Utsava Seva
Description:
On the occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi, the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar took part in the festive celebrations at Vinyasa Trust for the Differently Abled. Members actively engaged with the residents, helping in the set-up and arrangements, and adding to the festive atmosphere. Traditional delicacies such as Modaka, Chakli, and Kodbale were shared, creating a sense of warmth and togetherness.

The visit also included meaningful conversations with the management to understand the needs of the institution and explore ways in which the club could extend further support in the future. A motivational speech was delivered to the residents, inspiring them to celebrate the occasion with joy and positivity.

This initiative not only celebrated the spirit of Ganesh Chaturthi but also strengthened the club’s commitment to inclusivity and community service.

Name: Echoes of Culture
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar was delighted to be host an enriching international cultural exchange session titled “Echoes of Culture” along with the Rotaract Clubs of Arusha City & UDOM-Youth (District 9214, Tanzania) and Coimbatore Millennium (District 3206, India). The session featured a special guest speaker from Tanzania and turned out to be a lively and meaningful interaction, where members from different countries came together to learn about each other’s cultures, ask questions, share experiences and enjoy lighthearted moments of fun.

It was an evening filled with energy, laughter, and genuine connections, leaving all participants with full hearts and fond memories. This collaboration was a true celebration of the spirit of Rotaract, proving once again that when cultures meet, bonds spark, friendships grow, and memories last forever.

Name: Club Outing - Bengaluru Ganesha Utsava
Description: The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar went on a vibrant club outing to the 63rd Bengaluru Ganesh Utsav held at the National College Grounds, Basavanagudi. Members attended on both the 4th and 5th of September, with an enthusiastic turnout that made the evenings truly memorable. The first day featured the melodious performance of Rajesh Krishnan, while the second day brought the high-energy vibes of Raghu Dixit, both of which had our members completely immersed in music and celebration. It was a wonderful break from the midweek grind, giving our club’s music lovers an opportunity to bond, unwind, and enjoy the cultural richness of the festival together. The outing was filled with joy, laughter, and camaraderie, reinforcing the spirit of fellowship that makes our club special.

Name: Garba Utsav
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar had the pleasure of collaborating with the Rotaract Club of Bangalore Jayanagar for their vibrant and flagship event, Garba Utsav 2025. The evening was a lively celebration of culture, music, and togetherness, truly capturing the essence of the Navratri spirit.

Six Rotaractors from our club participated in the event, joining numerous enthusiastic dancers as we grooved to traditional Garba beats, shared laughter, and celebrated in full festive spirit. The energy throughout the night was infectious, creating an atmosphere of unity and joy that brought everyone together.

Beyond the celebrations, the event also carried a strong social message. The funds raised through Garba Utsav 2025 will be directed towards the installation of sanitary pad vending machines and incinerators, promoting menstrual hygiene and ensuring dignity for women and girls.
Areas of Focus: Fighting Disease, Saving Mothers and Children

Name: Emcee Sher
Description:
On 25th September 2025, the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar organized Emcee Sher: Masterclass, a professional development initiative designed to help Rotaractors strengthen their public speaking and hosting abilities. Conducted online via Google Meet, the session was facilitated by DRR Rtn. Rtr. Harsh Paresh Shinde, District Rotaract Representative of RID 3170, a seasoned professional anchor and founder of Prahas.
The masterclass was structured to benefit participants at all levels: those picking up the microphone for the first time, individuals working to build confidence on stage, and experienced hosts seeking to polish and refine their craft. The session offered practical insights into voice modulation, stage presence, audience engagement, and the art of confidently owning the spotlight.
Through this initiative, the club successfully provided its members and participants an opportunity to enhance their communication, leadership, and presentation skills—an important step towards building impactful Rotaractors who can lead events with confidence and charisma.

Name: Wildlife Conservation Walkathon
Description:
On 2nd October 2025, the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar actively participated in the 71st Wildlife Week Celebrations held at Vidhana Soudha, Bengaluru organised by Rotaract District 3191. The event aimed to spread awareness about the theme “Coexistence of Humans and Wildlife,” emphasizing the need for harmony between urban growth and ecological preservation.

A team of 10 enthusiastic members from our club took part in the Walkathon from Vidhana Soudha to Lalbagh, joining thousands of participants including members, environmentalists, NGOs and officials. The event beautifully reflected the Rotaract spirit of unity, service, and responsibility towards the environment.

Our presence at this significant public initiative not only demonstrated our club’s commitment to environmental awareness but also contributed to enhancing the public image and community engagement of the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar. Through this participation, we reaffirmed our belief that every small step counts when it comes to protecting our planet and promoting coexistence.

Name: Colors of Culture – A Rotaract Global Scrapbook
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar, RI District 3191, was proud to be a part of the international initiative “Colors of Culture – A Rotaract Global Scrapbook,” organized by the Rotaract Club of Wayamba University of Sri Lanka under their International Service Avenue.

This unique project brought together clubs from across the globe, including Rotaract Club of Ankara Cayyolu (RI District 2430) and Rotaract Club of Mumbai Nova (RI District 3141), to celebrate the richness of heritage, traditions, and artistic expressions from different parts of the world.

Representing Bengaluru and Karnataka, our club shared glimpses of India’s vibrant culture, values, and diversity while also learning about the fascinating traditions of other nations. The project truly embodied the spirit of global fellowship, cultural exchange, and mutual respect that defines Rotaract.

Through this collaboration, we not only strengthened international bonds but also deepened our appreciation for the world’s many colors of culture. A heartfelt appreciation to the Rotaract Club of Wayamba University of Sri Lanka and all partner clubs for creating a beautiful global mosaic of friendship and understanding.
Host Club: Rotaract Club of Wayamba University of Sri Lanka

Name: METROTHON – World Polio Day Initiative
Description:
On 24th October 2025, members of the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar joined hands with Rotary District 3191 and Rotaract District 3191 for METROTHON, a special initiative held to commemorate World Polio Day. The event aimed to raise awareness and reaffirm Rotary’s long-standing commitment to achieving a Polio-Free World — a mission that has inspired millions globally.

The event began at the MLR Convention Centre, Whitefield, with participants traveling together via metro to Garudacharpalya Metro Station, symbolizing unity and collective movement towards eradicating polio. It was an evening filled with purpose, energy, and fellowship.

Our club members enthusiastically took part in the awareness activities, engaging with Rotarians, fellow Rotaractors, and members of the public to spread the message of Rotary’s historic “End Polio Now” campaign. The event also provided wonderful opportunities for networking, collaboration, and community engagement, followed by a fellowship dinner.

Through this initiative, the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar once again reaffirmed its commitment to service above self and to being an active part of Rotary’s mission to eliminate polio from the face of the earth.

Name: Ink-Link
Description:
On 26th October 2025, the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar proudly collaborated with the Rotaract Club of Ratnapura, RI District 3220 (Sri Lanka) for “INK LINK” — a virtual international cultural and letterhead exchange that beautifully united Rotaractors from across the globe.

The event celebrated the spirit of global friendship, cultural understanding, and creativity, as clubs exchanged handwritten letters and uniquely designed letterheads that reflected their traditions, values, and identity. Participants shared stories and experiences that highlighted how culture transcends borders and how Rotaract continues to connect young minds worldwide.

Through this initiative, our club proudly represented Bengaluru and Karnataka, sharing our cultural essence while learning from the vibrant expressions of our international Rotaract friends. The session, hosted virtually via Google Meet, turned into a colorful showcase of art, emotion, and fellowship — reminding everyone that true connections are written not just in ink, but in understanding and unity.
Host Club: Rotaract Club of Ratnapura, RI District 3220 (Sri Lanka)

Name: Naada Habba 2025
Description:
On 2nd November 2025, Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar proudly participated in Naada Habba, the District’s grand celebration of Karnataka Rajyotsava, hosted at the culturally vibrant Janapada Loka. Our club marked a spirited start to the event with 18 enthusiastic members joining the rally from Pattanagere Metro Station to the venue, adding colour, energy, and unity to the morning procession.

The team immersed themselves in the rich traditions of Karnataka, celebrating the state’s heritage through vibrant ethnic attire in shades of yellow and red, rhythmic beats, and an atmosphere filled with festive pride. Members thoroughly enjoyed the cultural performances, including the inaugural and folk dances, showcasing Karnataka’s artistic legacy.

The formal proceedings—featuring flag hoisting, the ceremonial lighting of the lamp, addresses by district leaders, and felicitations—offered a meaningful reminder of the state’s cultural and linguistic identity. Overall, Naada Habba 2.0 was a day of unity, culture, and pride, where our members not only represented the club with enthusiasm but also celebrated Karnataka’s heritage with joy, respect, and true Rotaract spirit.

Name: Threads of Unity
Description:
On the occasion of Children’s Day, Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar carried out a meaningful edition of Threads of Unity, an initiative aimed at supporting young students through the provision of new school uniforms. Celebrating the spirit of childhood, dignity, and equal opportunity, the project brought warmth and joy to the students of the Government Primary School in Hosadurga.

A total of 212 children received brand-new uniforms through this drive, creating a visible sense of happiness and pride among the students. Valued at ₹73,000+, this distribution served as a reminder that even a simple uniform can strengthen a child’s confidence and sense of belonging in the classroom.

Rotary and Rotaract members joined hands to ensure smooth execution, contributing to a cheerful and memorable Children’s Day for the school. The enthusiasm of the children, teachers, and volunteers highlighted the true impact of collective service.

Threads of Unity continues to stand as a powerful example of how compassion and collaboration can make a lasting difference in a child’s educational journey.

Name: Grantha
Description:
Rotaract Bengaluru JP Nagar, in collaboration with the Rotaract Club of Debo, Ethiopia, successfully executed GRANTHA – The International Book Donation Drive, an initiative that embodied knowledge-sharing, cross-border goodwill, and the spirit of global Rotaract fellowship.

Through the collective support of donors and well-wishers, the project gathered an inspiring collection of 200+ books, ranging from storybooks and children’s literature to academic guides and competitive exam material. These books were donated to the Hosadurga Public Library, strengthening its growing collection and creating wider learning opportunities for students and readers within the community.

The initiative not only promoted literacy and accessibility but also demonstrated the meaningful impact of international collaboration. GRANTHA stands as a testament to how shared purpose and compassion can transcend borders, inspiring communities and enriching educational journeys through the power of books.

Name: Pages of Possibilities
Description:
As part of the Children’s Day celebrations, the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar, along with Rotaract Bangalore Aagneya and Rotaract Shantiniketan, executed Pages of Possibility, a meaningful stationery distribution initiative designed to support and inspire young learners.

Through this collaborative effort, 440 stationery kits were distributed to children of the Government Primary School in Hosadurga. Each kit was curated with essential educational supplies to encourage consistent learning, spark curiosity, and help students engage more confidently in their studies.

The combined presence of the partnering clubs added energy, efficiency, and warmth to the programme, ensuring a smooth distribution and a memorable Children’s Day celebration for the students. Pages of Possibility demonstrated how shared service and unified intent can create lasting academic encouragement for young minds.

Name: Tech Bridge
Description:
As part of the Children’s Day service projects, the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar, in collaboration with Rotaract Bangalore Aagneya, implemented Tech Bridge, an initiative intended to expand digital access and enhance learning opportunities for students and community members.

Under this project, 4 laptops were contributed to the Government Primary School and the Hosadurga Village Library. These devices will serve as shared digital resources, supporting classroom learning, library activities, and the development of essential computer skills among students.

The collaboration ensured effective coordination, smooth execution, and an interactive engagement with the children and school staff. Tech Bridge reflects how meaningful partnerships can help bridge digital gaps and empower students with tools that build confidence and open pathways to future opportunities.

Name: The Bengaluru Makeover
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar actively participated in The Bengaluru Makeover, a large-scale beautification and clean-up initiative organised by Rotaract District 3191 in collaboration with Rotary Bengaluru Bannerghatta Road and the Karnataka Forest Department. The drive aimed to transform a public stretch into a vibrant, litter-free zone through mural art, wall painting, and sustained community clean-up efforts.

Our members engaged enthusiastically in the painting activities, contributing to beautifully curated murals while prominently incorporating Rotaract branding across designated sections. The team also participated in the cleanathon, ensuring the surroundings were cleaned, decluttered, and prepared before painting.

The event began with a morning briefing and an inaugural ceremony in the presence of distinguished guests, followed by guided painting sessions led by the organising team. Members adhered to the painting scheme, safety protocols, and coordination guidelines to ensure uniformity and quality in the final artwork. A mid-session refreshments break helped keep spirits high as volunteers continued their efforts until the project wind-up at 2:00 PM.

The Bengaluru Makeover served as an inspiring example of collective service, creativity, and civic responsibility—demonstrating how unity and effort can transform public spaces into cleaner, brighter, and more welcoming environments.
Venue: Sakalwara Road, Basavanapura (Near Bannerghatta National Park)

Name: Kadlekai Parshe
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar organised a vibrant club service outing to Kadalekayi Parishe 2025, Bengaluru’s iconic annual groundnut festival celebrated along the historic Bull Temple Road. This visit provided members with an opportunity to experience the city’s cultural richness while strengthening fellowship in an informal, festive setting.

Members explored the beautifully lit streets filled with artisans, local delicacies, traditional displays, and the year’s first harvest of groundnuts—an integral part of the festival’s heritage. The evening was marked by joyful conversations, shared experiences, and plenty of photo opportunities, capturing the colours and spirit of this centuries-old celebration.

The outing not only offered a refreshing cultural immersion but also helped members bond beyond project spaces, reinforcing the club’s spirit of camaraderie and togetherness.

Name: Mandala Art Workshop
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar organised a soothing and beginner-friendly Mandala Art Workshop at RV Dental College on November 30, 2025. The session was facilitated by Medha S Kashyap, who introduced participants to the calming world of mandala creation — a meditative art form rooted in Sanskrit, symbolising the “circle.”

The workshop guided members through the basics of symmetry, simple geometric patterns, and the foundational techniques required to create their own mandalas from scratch. Emphasising mindfulness and relaxation, the facilitator explained how the repetitive, circular patterns of mandala art help improve focus, reduce stress, boost creativity, and promote emotional clarity. Members thoroughly enjoyed the peaceful pace of the workshop, which offered not just an artistic experience but also a moment of introspection and healing.

The session served as a refreshing weekend break that blended creativity, wellness, and connection, reinforcing the club’s commitment to holistic professional development and member well-being.

Name: Party in Pink 4.0
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar, in successful collaboration with the Rotaract Club of SSMRV College, proudly organized its flagship event “Party in Pink 4.0”, the fourth edition of our signature Breast Cancer Awareness cum Zumba Fundraiser. Over the years, Party in Pink has evolved into a meaningful movement that blends awareness, wellness, and community participation, and this edition stood as a powerful testament to that legacy.

Held on 14th December 2025 at the SSMRV Degree College, the event witnessed the enthusiastic participation of over 150 individuals, all coming together with a shared purpose — to support the treatment of breast cancer patients and spread awareness about early detection and healthy living.

This year, Party in Pink 4.0 successfully raised over ₹2,00,000 in monetary donations, which will be donated to the Sri Shankara Cancer Foundation towards the treatment and care of breast cancer patients. The overwhelming response and generosity from participants, well-wishers, and collaborating clubs reaffirmed the collective commitment towards this noble cause.

The event was graced by an esteemed panel of dignitaries. The Guest of Honour, Padma Shri Dr. Vijayalakshmi Deshmane, a legendary oncologist and an inspiration in the field of cancer care, was felicitated for her immense contribution to society and her lifelong service to oncology. The Chief Guest, Smt. Divya Hosur, Indian Defence Estate Officer for the Karnataka Circle, honored the occasion with her presence and encouraging words. We were also privileged to have Dr. Vijayshree Lakshman, Principal of SSMRV Degree College, and Dr. Srivatsa, Senior Specialist at Sri Shankara Cancer Foundation, join us for the event.

The formal session commenced with inspiring and thought-provoking addresses by the dignitaries, emphasizing the importance of awareness, compassion, and collective responsibility. This was followed by the formal handing over of the donation cheque, felicitation of the Chief Guest and Guest of Honour, and recognition of individuals and contributors who played a pivotal role in making the event a success.

Beyond celebration, Party in Pink 4.0 also served as a vital knowledge-sharing platform. The doctors and dignitaries spoke extensively on early breast cancer screening, early detection methods, available treatments and remedies, as well as lifestyle changes and preventive measures that can significantly contribute to leading a healthy life. These insights left a lasting impact on the audience, reinforcing the true purpose of the event.
Following the formal proceedings, the atmosphere transformed into one of vibrant energy and celebration with a high-octane Zumba session. Four dynamic Zumba instructors took over the stage, captivating the audience with their electrifying performances, infectious enthusiasm, and powerful choreography. The session was not only a fitness experience but also a joyful expression of unity, strength, and hope.

After the lively Zumba session, participants engaged in warm fellowship and camaraderie, capturing heartfelt moments with friends, fellow Rotaractors, and guests. The event concluded with a sumptuous breakfast, leaving everyone with a sense of fulfillment, happiness, and purpose.

Party in Pink 4.0 was further elevated by the presence of well-wishers from over five Rotary Clubs, more than twelve Rotaract Clubs, a US delegate who served as a District Governor of a district in the USA, representatives from a Chartered Accountancy firm, along with friends and family members who extended their unwavering support.
In every sense, Party in Pink 4.0 was more than just an event — it was a celebration of resilience, awareness, collaboration, and social responsibility. The overwhelming participation, impactful knowledge sharing, successful fundraising, and heartfelt fellowship made this edition a memorable milestone in the journey of the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar and Rotaract Club of SSMRV College.
Venue: SSMRV Degree College, Jayanagar 4th T Block
Areas of Focus: Fighting Disease, Saving Mothers and Children

Name: Christmas Carnival 2.0
Description:
Christmas Carnival 2.0 was a heartwarming community service initiative organized in association with KPMG CSR, aimed at spreading joy and festive cheer among the students of Sharon School, Jallahalli. The event was held on 20th December 2025, from 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM, creating a memorable Christmas celebration for the children.
The carnival featured a range of fun games and engaging activities, encouraging enthusiastic participation from the students. Adding to the festive spirit, the school students performed a play and presented a choir performance of Christmas jingles, which brought warmth and cheer to the occasion.

The event also included sessions and narrations on the Advent of Baby Jesus, highlighting the origin and significance of Christmas and reinforcing values of love, compassion, and togetherness. A model of Jerusalem showcased by the students offered a meaningful visual representation of the Christmas story, while the decoration of the Christmas tree became a joyful collective activity that enhanced the festive atmosphere.
Throughout the event, the campus was filled with laughter, excitement, and celebration, as volunteers and students shared moments of joy and bonding. Christmas Carnival 2.0 successfully served as a platform to celebrate the spirit of giving and inclusivity, leaving the students with cherished memories and reinforcing the true essence of Christmas — spreading happiness, hope, and goodwill.

Name: Cultural Canvas
Description:
Cultural Canvas, an international cultural exchange initiative conducted under Project Beyond Boundaries, served as a vibrant platform for global connection, learning, and fellowship by bringing together 35+ Rotaractors from multiple Rotary International Districts across the world on a single virtual stage. The programme was designed to celebrate diversity while fostering mutual respect and understanding among young leaders from different cultural, social, and geographical backgrounds.

The exchange witnessed enthusiastic participation from Agora Rotaract Kulubu (RID 2440 – Turkey), Charumati Rotaract Club (RID 3292 – Nepal), Rotaract Club Luiz de Queiroz (RID 4621 – Brazil), Rotaract Club of Ratnapura (RID 3220 – Sri Lanka), Rotaract Nakawa MUBS (RID 9213 – Uganda), Rotaract Chihuahua San Felipe (RID 4110 – Mexico), and the Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar (RID 3191 – India). Each participating club curated and presented immersive insights into their nation’s cultural identity, highlighting traditional customs, festivals, cuisine, music, art forms, social practices, and everyday lifestyles. These presentations offered participants a rare and enriching opportunity to experience the world through diverse cultural lenses.

The programme was intentionally structured to be highly interactive and participatory, with dedicated Q&A sessions following every presentation. These segments encouraged open dialogue, curiosity, and knowledge-sharing, as participants engaged in thoughtful discussions around cultural practices, linguistic diversity, regional festivals, social norms, and day-to-day life across different countries. A particularly noteworthy aspect of the exchange was the strong interest expressed by international participants in Indian culture, which led to engaging conversations on India’s vast diversity, traditions, and cultural pluralism.

True to the spirit of Project Beyond Boundaries, the initiative successfully achieved its core objectives by breaking geographical barriers, strengthening international fellowship, and promoting the values of global citizenship. Cultural Canvas not only deepened cultural awareness but also fostered meaningful connections, friendships, and a sense of shared purpose among Rotaractors worldwide. Overall, the initiative created a lasting impact by reinforcing Rotaract’s commitment to international service, cultural appreciation, and youth-led global collaboration, proving that meaningful connections can indeed transcend borders.

Name: Balanced Diet for a Healthy Life
Description:
The Rotaract Club of Bangalore JP Nagar, in collaboration with the Rotaract Club of Banashankari and the Rotaract Club of PES University, participated in and collaborated for an online awareness session titled “Balanced Diet for a Healthy Life”, held on 30th December 2025 via Google Meet.

The session focused on promoting holistic well-being by highlighting the importance of nutrition and balanced lifestyle practices. The resource speaker for the session was Dr. Lalitha Priya, associated with Sagar Chandramma Hospital and Prameya Health Pvt Ltd, who shared valuable insights on maintaining physical and mental health through mindful dietary choices.

The discussion covered the role of a balanced diet in everyday life, simple habits that contribute to long-term wellness, and practical approaches to improving overall health. The session was informative and engaging, enabling participants to gain clarity on nutrition-related concepts and adopt healthier lifestyle practices.

The interactive nature of the session encouraged active participation from members across various Rotaract and community clubs, fostering collaboration and shared learning. The initiative reflected the spirit of “Unite for Good”, reinforcing the importance of collective efforts in spreading health awareness.

Overall, the session served as a meaningful platform for knowledge sharing and awareness, contributing positively towards community well-being through collaborative engagement.
Host Club: Rotaract Club of Banashankari and the Rotaract Club of PES University
